title: Repository whose manifests and deployment configuration do not parse
why: §9.1 forbids partial or unknown input from asserting absence. A broken manifest must produce a diagnostic and PARTIAL completeness, never a confident empty dependency set.

absent_facts.note: the manifest naming express is unparseable, so the dependency is unknown rather than present
nothing parsed, so nothing can be judged unused
the compose file did not parse; no workload may be claimed from it
